name: Ready stance
description: Knees bent, chest up, weight over the middle of the feet. Everything else is built on this.

name: Falling safely & getting up
description: Fall forward onto your pads, slide it out, and stand back up through a kneel.
cues: Get low before you go down
Knee pads first, then wrist guards, and slide
Up: one knee, other skate flat, hands on knee, stand

name: Forward stride
description: Push out to the side and recover under the hips, alternating feet.
cues: Bring the foot back under you before the next push

name: Forward swizzles
description: Two-foot lemon shapes: heels in, toes out, then squeeze back together.
cues: Press out through the heels, pull in with the inner thighs

name: One-foot glide
description: Hold a balanced glide on one foot for several seconds, both sides.
cues: Hips stacked over the gliding skate
Free foot lifted beside the ankle

name: A-frame turn
description: Wide-stance turn steered by pressing the outside skate onto its inside edge.
cues: Look and point where you are going

name: Two-foot hop
description: Jump off both skates while rolling and land balanced.
cues: Bend deep, spring, absorb the landing

name: Plow stop
description: Push skates out into a wide V (inline) or pigeon-toe (quad) and scrub off speed.
cues: Wide stance, then press the heels out
Low hips, push into the ground

name: Heel brake stop
description: Scissor the braking foot forward and lift its toe to press the heel brake.
cues: Brake foot forward until knees overlap
Lift the toe and press down through the heel
Most weight stays on the back leg

name: Toe-stop drag
description: Glide on one foot and drag the other toe stop behind you to slow down.
cues: Drag foot turned out, behind the glide foot
Weight stays on the front leg

name: T-stop
description: Drag the back skate at a right angle behind the glide skate to brake.
cues: Back skate at 90° behind the heel
Light drag first, then add pressure

name: Inside & outside edges
description: Hold curves on each edge of each foot. These are the base of every turn and crossover.
cues: Outside edges are the hard ones, so go slow

name: Heel-to-instep glide
description: Glide on one foot and bring the free heel in to the instep of the gliding foot, toes turned out, so the feet make a T. This is the open-hip position a mohawk needs, without the turn. A few short glides each side.
cues: Free heel to the gliding instep, toes out
Open the free hip, don’t twist the shoulders
Hold for a count of three, then put it down

name: Mohawk at the rail
description: Holding a rail or wall, roll forward very slowly, open the hips and step onto the other foot facing backward. 5 each direction, then try one with just a fingertip on the rail.
cues: Heels point at each other as you step
Turn the hips open first, the foot follows
Tiny speed, it’s about the position

name: Parallel turn
description: Turn with skates close together, leaning on matching edges.
cues: Lean from the ankles, not the shoulders
Shoulders rotate into the turn first

name: Backward swizzles
description: Lemons rolling backwards: toes in, heels out.
cues: Weight on the balls of the feet

name: Two-foot turn
description: Turn from forward to backward (and back) on both skates while rolling.

name: Backward C-cuts
description: Backward pushes drawing C shapes with alternating skates.
cues: Push from the front wheels outward
Keep hips square to your line
Check behind you every few strides

name: Forward crossovers
description: Step the outside skate over the inside one around a curve.
cues: Power comes from the under-leg on its outside edge
Lift and place the crossing skate, don’t swing it

name: Mohawk turn
description: Step from forward to backward onto the other foot, heels pointing at each other.
cues: Open the free heel toward the gliding heel

name: Backward crossovers
description: Cross the front skate over while skating backwards around a curve.

name: Powerslide
description: Skate backwards, then open into a sideways slide on the leading skate to stop.
cues: Commit your weight to the sliding leg

name: Hop over an obstacle
description: Clear a small object, like a shoe or a stick, while rolling.
cues: Lift the knees, don’t just pull the feet up

name: Rolling on rough ground
description: Stay loose over cracks, pebbles and patched asphalt.
cues: Lower stance, one foot slightly ahead
Weight back a touch over cracks

name: Long efficient stride
description: Fewer, longer pushes with a full glide on each foot.
cues: Glide until speed drops, then push
Count strides per lap and cut the number

name: Steady endurance skate
description: Twenty minutes or more at a steady effort, holding form as you tire.
cues: Check your knee bend every lap

name: Rolling off a curb
description: Roll off a curb without slowing down or stepping.
cues: Staggered stance, front foot leads off
Bend as you drop to absorb

name: Hill speed control
description: Use slalom turns and drags to stay in control going downhill.

name: Sprint intervals
description: Short hard efforts with easy recovery laps.

name: Double push
description: Each stroke sweeps in under the body on the outside edge, then pushes out on the inside edge.
cues: Start the stroke on the outside edge under you
Roll onto the inside edge and push out

name: Rolling a bank or small quarter
description: Roll partway up, stall, and come back down backwards (fakie).
cues: Lean into the ramp, not away from it
Look back as you come down
Go a little higher each time

name: Pumping transitions
description: Gain speed by compressing into the flat and extending up the wall.
cues: Compress at the bottom, extend up the wall
Count how many pumps you can link

name: Drop in
description: Start on the coping and roll into the ramp.
cues: Back skate on the coping, front skate over the edge
Look down the ramp, not at your feet

name: Kick turn on the wall
description: Turn at the top of the transition and come back down forwards.
cues: Rotate the shoulders at the peak

name: Stall on the coping
description: Ride up, stall on the coping, and drop back in.
cues: Unweight as you reach the top
Set the skates on the deck or coping

name: Carving the bowl
description: Link pumps and carves around the walls of a bowl.
cues: Tight crossovers in the shallow end

name: 180 air on a quarter
description: Leave the coping, rotate 180° and land back into the ramp.
cues: Rotate with the head and shoulders
Land on the transition, not the flat

name: Coping grind
description: Lock onto the coping and slide along it before dropping back in.
cues: Lock the grind plate onto the coping
Stay over the top, don’t lean back

name: 360 air
description: A full rotation out of the ramp and back in.
cues: Spot the landing over your shoulder

name: Hop up a curb
description: Hop onto a curb while rolling, landing on both skates.

name: Gap jump
description: Jump for distance across a gap you mark out (chalk lines, two bags).
cues: Speed does the work, not the jump
Extend in the air, tuck to land

name: Flat 180 jump
description: Jump, rotate 180° and land rolling backwards.
cues: Wind up the shoulders, then release
Land on both skates, knees bent

name: Flat 360 jump
description: A full rotation jump on flat ground.
cues: Land on a slight curve, not dead straight

name: Frontside grind
description: Lock both skates across a ledge and slide.
cues: Look at the end of the ledge

name: Soul grind
description: Front skate grinds on the H-block, back skate on the soul plate.
cues: Back foot on the soul plate

name: Royale
description: Front skate on the H-block, back foot’s outside soul plate behind you.

name: Rolling down stairs
description: Ride down a short stair set staying loose over each step.
cues: Let the knees absorb each step

name: Rail grind
description: Frontside on a round rail.
cues: Grind a low rail or ledge edge first
Hands out, eyes on the end

name: Jumping a stair set
description: Clear a stair set in one jump.
cues: Pick a set you can already roll
Pop off the last flat section

name: Skating to the beat
description: Time strides and swizzles to music, changing moves on the beat.
cues: Stay relaxed in the upper body

name: Heel-toe roll
description: Roll with one skate on its heel and the other on its toe.
cues: Stagger the feet a skate-length apart

name: Crazy legs
description: Alternating heel-toe swizzle footwork, a jam skating staple.

name: Shoot the duck
description: Glide on one deeply bent leg with the other extended forward.

name: Two-foot spin
description: Spin in place on both skates.
cues: Wind up, then pull the arms in
Weight on the balls of the feet
Spot a point to avoid dizziness

name: Toe-stop spin
description: Spin on the toe stops.
cues: Rise up onto the toes from a two-foot spin

name: Three-turn
description: One-foot turn from forward to backward, tracing a 3 on the floor.
cues: Check the shoulders against the turn
Rise as you turn, sink after
Start from a slow forward edge

name: Spread eagle
description: Glide on both skates heels-in, toes pointing outward.

name: Grapevine
description: Weaving footwork that turns between forward and backward continuously.
cues: Feet trace an S along the floor
Slow the count down to learn it

name: Waltz jump
description: Half-rotation jump from a forward outside edge to a back outside edge.

name: One-foot spin
description: Centred spin on one skate (scratch spin).
cues: Enter from a back outside edge
Free leg crosses in to speed up

name: Forward fish
description: Swizzle through a cone line, both skates on either side of each cone.

name: Criss-cross
description: Cross and uncross the skates around alternate cones.
cues: Cross on one cone, open on the next

name: Snake
description: Skates in line, one behind the other, weaving through the cones.
cues: Both skates follow the same track

name: Backward fish
description: The fish, rolling backwards.
cues: Look over the shoulder down the line

name: Heel wheeling
description: Roll on the back wheels of both skates.

name: One-foot slalom
description: Weave the line on a single skate.

name: Backward criss-cross
description: The criss-cross, rolling backwards.

name: Eagle
description: Spread-eagle position travelling through the cones.
cues: Open hips before the first cone
Keep the heels facing each other

name: Bodyweight squats
description: 3 × 15, slow down and quick up. The skating position under load.
cues: Chest up, knees track over toes
Hold the bottom for a second

name: Wall sit
description: Hold a skating-depth sit against a wall. 3 × 45 seconds.

name: Single-leg balance
description: Stand on one leg for 30 seconds, then with eyes closed.

name: Calf raises & ankle mobility
description: Slow calf raises plus knee-to-wall ankle stretches.

name: Glute bridges & band walks
description: Bridges plus side steps with a resistance band: the push muscles.
cues: Squeeze at the top of the bridge
Band above knees, stay low on side steps

name: Plank & side plank
description: Core holds that keep your upper body quiet on skates.
cues: Straight line from head to heels

name: Hip & hamstring mobility
description: Five stretches after skating, about 8 minutes. Hold each for 30–45 seconds per side, easing in without bouncing; mild tension is right, sharp pain is not.
cues: Kneeling hip flexor: one knee down, other foot ahead; tuck the hips under and shift forward until the front of the back hip stretches
Hamstring with a strap: lying on your back, loop a towel round one foot and raise the straight leg until the back of the thigh stretches
Butterfly: sit with soles together and knees out, back tall; lean forward from the hips for the inner thighs
Side lunge hold: feet wide, sit back into one bent knee with the other leg straight, toes up; stretches the inner thigh of the straight leg
Figure-4: lying down, cross one ankle over the other knee and pull that thigh toward your chest for the outer hip and glute

name: Fall rolls on a mat
description: Practise knee slides and shoulder rolls on a soft surface.
cues: Get low before you go down

name: Lateral lunges
description: Side-to-side lunges that copy the push of a stride.
cues: Sit back into the bent leg

name: Single-leg box squat
description: Sit down to a box on one leg and stand back up.

name: Skater bounds
description: Bound side to side, landing on one leg and sticking it.
cues: Land soft and hold one second

name: Balance board drills
description: Balance board or cushion: two-foot then one-foot holds.

name: Spin & spotting drill
description: Turns in socks on a smooth floor, practising spotting.
cues: Fix your eyes on one point

name: Tuck jumps
description: Explosive jumps pulling the knees to the chest.

name: 180 & 360 jumps in shoes
description: Rotation jumps on the spot to learn the timing off skates.

name: Pistol squat progression
description: Work toward a full one-leg squat.

name: Hip circles & 90/90 switches
description: Gentle hip rotation, about 4 minutes. Seated 90/90 switches, 2 × 8, then 5 slow standing hip circles each way per leg.
cues: Sit tall and let both knees fall side to side together
Only go as far as is comfortable

name: Clamshells & side leg lifts
description: Strength for the muscles that turn your hips out. Lying on your side, 2 × 12 clamshells, then 2 × 10 side leg lifts, each side.
cues: Heels together, lift the top knee
Keep the pelvis still, don’t roll back
Add a light band when 15 feels easy

name: Standing turnout hold
description: Hold a wall, heels together, and turn both feet out from the hips as far as is comfortable. Hold 20 seconds, then 8 small knee bends in that position. 3 rounds.
cues: Turn from the hips, not the knees or feet
Squeeze the backs of the hips

name: Mohawk steps in shoes
description: Walk the mohawk step on flat ground: step forward, bring the free heel to the standing heel, turn the hips open and step back onto it facing backward. 2 × 6 each direction.
cues: Open the hips before the step
Eyes and shoulders lead the turn

name: Cossack squats
description: A deep side lunge with the straight leg’s toes pointing up, for hip strength at the end of your range. 2 × 5 each side, holding a doorframe at first.
cues: Only as deep as you can come back up from
